messages.subject: Update to v0.60.3
parts:
Hello,
I have made a minor update to v0.60.3.

The function "group.graph.diffs" now properly returns a graph with spatial coordinates so that graph can be plotted. The GUI (plot_brainGraph_gui) now allows for specification of a custom edge attribute to adjust edge width.

Chris
